ruling.recommended_action: Issue Ryde voucher of S$8.24 (4.45 km unattributed detour × S$1.41/km metered rate) to the rider; note driver's RD-1 breach (deviated to a 7-Eleven off the shortest route without naming the location to the rider beforehand).

segment_findings.reason: Out-and-back off-route segment (GPS: westward to 1.3135,103.8884 by 17:41:10, stationary until ~17:45:10, retracing east from 1.3119,103.8892 at 17:45:40), absent from the quoted polyline. RD-3(a) not met (rider named no 7-Eleven location; driver chose the store). RD-3(b): driver's self-chosen store produced the off-route segment and its location was never disclosed to the rider, so the rider's general 'stop on the way' consent does not exempt it. RD-5 not met (the 17:33:55 'Ok' does not identify or agree to this segment). RD-4 not met (no traffic incident on the substituted optimal-route stretch; only band 4 records, which do not exempt under RD-4(b)). Therefore not exempt; refund under RD-2.
